text: A fresh rennet curd is spread into a thin sheet and baked on both sides until dark-spotted; the heat firms the squeaky curd and browns its surface, and the cheese is ready to eat straight after baking.

steps.note: With salt added to the milk.
Into a flat sheet 0.5–3 cm thick.

steps.name: bake
steps.note: On both sides, in an oven, under a grill or by open fire.
